title: Poverty headcounts under a hypothetical uniform 10% real consumption loss, 2024 bins

metadata.scenario: Hypothetical uniform 10% real consumption loss, not a forecast or transition probability.
metadata.formula: sum(pop where welf*(1-loss)<line) / sum(pop) * 100; loss is 0 or 0.10
metadata.resolution: Approximately 0.1 percentage point; baseline and scenario both use the same 1,000 population bins.
metadata.differenceFromHeadline: Bin headcounts approximate the full-precision Country_FGT lineup estimates.
